name: Tareq Matar Al Hassani Auto Accessories
headline: LUXURY VIP CAR CONVERSION IN DUBAI
lede: VIP vehicle conversion in Dubai specializing in luxury car interiors, Mercedes V-Class, Toyota Hiace, Land Cruiser customization, and premium auto accessories.
about: Complete your VIP vehicle upgrade with premium paint protection. TMAHAAF VIP PPF in Dubai helps protect luxury, performance, and customized vehicles from road debris, light scratches, and everyday wear while preserving the vehicle's finish.

Tareq Matar Al Hassani Auto Accessories Fitting L.L.C. (TMAHAAF) is a Dubai-based vehicle customization company specializing in VIP conversions, interior upgrades, and passenger-comfort solutions for clients across the UAE and GCC.
